name: Ride to Ironforge
label: Quest
description: You carry Brock Stoneseeker's list from Thelsamar to Golnir Bouldertoe at Ironforge's Great Forge. The names belong to Brock's top mining students.

clips.title: The story
paras: You carry Brock Stoneseeker's list from Thelsamar to Golnir Bouldertoe at Ironforge's Great Forge. The names belong to Brock's top mining students.

Young mountaineers and travelers often make their first gryphon flight between Thelsamar and Ironforge. Gryphon Master Thorgrum Borrelson handles the trip, carrying travelers over Dun Morogh's snowy ridges and into the mountain fortress.

Brock Stoneseeker sends word from Thelsamar about his most promising mining pupils. At the Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe inscribes their names on ceremonial honorary picks, recognizing their hard work in Loch Modan's quarries and mines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge. From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe. You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild. That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!
Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What can I do for you, sir?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils. I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go. I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
